goal: Verify that an application reaches an expected visible state and presents clear completion cues.

specifications.title: Confirm initial visible state
specifications.goal: Confirm that the application opens to a stable, recognizable initial state.
specifications.setup: Begin from the documented normal starting state.
assertions: The expected primary application surface is visible.
A clear state cue indicates that initialization has completed.

specifications.title: Confirm one bounded interaction
specifications.goal: Exercise one documented interaction and verify its visible outcome.
specifications.setup: Use only controls described in the approved operating manual.
assertions: The selected control responds without an unexpected blocking state.
The visible result matches the documented expected outcome.

verification_plan: Create through typed authoring, review deterministic readiness, then explicitly choose whether to stop or run the whole project.
